lines.beaver: 민지야, 이 상가는 가게마다 값이 다르네.
lines.beaver_en: Minji, prices differ from store to store in this arcade.
lines.beaver_roman: minjiya, i sangganeun gagemada gapssi dareune.
lines.learner: 응, 이 상가에서 여기가 제일 싸.
lines.en: Yeah, this place is the cheapest in the arcade.
lines.roman: eung, i sanggaeseo yeogiga jeil ssa.

lines.en: Yes, I'm a regular, so I know the owner well.

lines.beaver: 이 운동화 얼마야? 처음 보는 거네.
lines.beaver_en: How much are these sneakers? I've never seen them.
lines.beaver_roman: i undonghwa eolmaya? cheoeum boneun geone.
lines.learner: 사만 원이야. 정가보다 만 원 싸.
lines.en: It's 40,000 won. That's 10,000 won below list price.
lines.roman: saman woniya. jeonggaboda man won ssa.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, so how much was it at that store?
lines.learner: 저 가게는 오만 원이야. 여기가 훨씬 싸지.
lines.en: That store charges 50,000 won. It's much cheaper here.
lines.roman: jeo gageneun oman woniya. yeogiga hwolssin ssaji.

lines.beaver_en: But if it's too cheap, isn't it junk?
lines.en: No, unlike cheap goods, the quality is good.

lines.beaver_en: Then should I buy one too?
lines.learner: 응, 여기서 사는 게 제일 이득이야.
lines.en: Yes, buying here is the best deal.
lines.roman: eung, yeogiseo saneun ge jeil ideugiya.

lines.beaver: 저 사람은 왜 저렇게 많이 사?
lines.beaver_en: Why is that person buying so much?
lines.beaver_roman: jeo sarameun wae jeoreoke mani sa?
lines.learner: 많이 사면 더 싸게 해 줘서 그래.
lines.en: It's because they give a discount if you buy a lot.
lines.roman: mani samyeon deo ssage hae jwoseo geurae.

lines.beaver_en: The checkout is crowded. Let's get in line quickly.
lines.learner: 잠깐, 나 할인권이 있어. 같이 쓰자.
lines.en: Wait, I have a discount coupon. Let's use it together.
lines.roman: jamkkan, na harinkkwoni isseo. gachi sseuja.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, thanks! Shall we look at other things too?
lines.en: Sure, household goods are cheaper than at other stores too.

lines.beaver: 좋아, 그럼 더 둘러보고 같이 계산하자.
lines.beaver_en: Great, let's look around more and pay together.
lines.beaver_roman: joa, geureom deo dulleobogo gachi gyesanhaja.
lines.en: Okay, let's pick everything and go to the checkout!
